title: Orbit Kart Grand Prix 星环卡丁大奖赛
description: A three-dimensional kart racer across three hand-tuned star-ring circuits. Drift through the bend to charge a two-stage boost, grab question boxes for a dash, a homing bolt or a roadblock, and hold off three rubber-band AI rivals over three laps. Grand Prix mode packs a full four-kart race; Time Trial strips it back to a solo hunt for the perfect lap. Best finish and fastest lap are saved per circuit in localStorage.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to drive, Shift + steering to drift and charge a boost (release to launch), E or Space to use an item, R to rejoin the track, P or Esc to pause, M to mute. Touch devices get left/right, brake, drift and item buttons. Pick Grand Prix or Time Trial and a circuit on the title screen; cross the line three times to finish.
author: LightGame
